jobs.description:
As junior Sous Chef in Newrest, your job main area of responsibility is to ensure the quality level for product and processes in the hot and cold kitchen, including SPML (special meal) preparation and canteen (staff food). Also your role is to ensure a smooth and effective staff planning in both hot and cold kitchen according to forecast, laws, and internal agreements.
Ensure an effective production in the hot and cold kitchen, fulfilling the targets for efficiency, quality, and food safety.
"Hands on" cooking with the chefs, to ensure correct level of quality and efficiency.
Main Duties & Responsibilities
·      Daily management of the employees, including time keeping
·      Short- and long-term planning of workload including hot fill and sous vide, bulk production
·      Control, and optimize work processes for better efficiency
·      Instruction and training of all groups of employees impacting the quality level in the kitchen
·      Focus on waste management, related to product throughout the whole production
·      Participate in menu presentation, where new menus are produced and presented to the customer.
·      Check new menus and rotations, before implementation
·      Ensure high level of quality and cleanliness according to service level agreements and local HACCP regulations
·      Ensure all CCP's (Critical Control Point) are captured and registered. Storing, cooking and cooling
·      Control cooking processes in Hot Fill and Sous Vide Production
·      Produce and execute chef table (show case and check the food, together with customer and commercial team).
·      Plan and execute "Top Table" (daily control of produced food, with signoff)
·      Ensure a smooth cooperation with all other departments in the unit.
Work Experience
·    Experienced in managing employees in a production setup
·    Minimum 3-4 years as a chef.
·    Preferably in-flight or related catering experience, is an advantage
·    Culinary experience from 4* or 5* hotels and/or high-level restaurants, is an advantage
Skills & Knowledge
·      Good interpersonal and communication skills
·      Understanding of large-scale production and assembly
·      Highly experienced with QA (Quality assurance) and hygiene processes in a production kitchen
·      Culinary understanding
·      PC user - comfortable using Microsoft Office
·      Excellent oral and written communication skills in Swedish and English language
Type of employment - temporary (vik)
Salary SEK34000-36000 monthly
Competencies to be successful in the position
·       Thinking: Information search and analysis and problem-solving skills
·       Engaging: Understanding others, team leadership and people development
·       Inspiring: Influencing and building relationships, motivating, inspiring, and communicating effectively
·       Achieving: Delivering business results under pressure, championing performance improvement and customer focus
The following are the QHSE accountabilities of all Newrest employees:
Follow all applicable policies and procedures required for the successful execution of the job.
Follow the QHSE Policy and meet the requirements of the organizations’ Management system in compliance with Food Safety & Quality, Occupational Health & Safety and Environmental Management System.
Ensure that all HACCP, Good Manufacturing Practices, Good Hygiene Practices, Health and Safety Procedures and Policies are followed in the department and run smoothly and consistently.
Ensure to submit all necessary quality related reports and answer or give an input to all quality related enquires on timely basis.
Ensure to take all corrections and corrective actions necessary to correct occurred non-conformities within area of responsibilities and fill necessary documentation regarding this.”

About us
EcoPhi builds hardware for digital substations. Our two products are the CMPC800, a centralised substation server, and the QMU800, a modular merging unit. Utilities and system integrators use them to modernise the grid with IEC 61850-based protection, control and monitoring.
We are looking for an application engineer who will push our products to their limits in the lab, so they never fail in the field.
The role
You are responsible for our test lab. You build realistic substation setups, run the CMPC800 and QMU800 through normal operation, edge cases and failure scenarios, and find the problems before our customers do. Your findings go straight to R&D and inform the next release.
You also bring that knowledge to customers. You know how our products behave, so you help customers configure them, test them and put them into service.
What you will do
Lab and experimental setup
Build and maintain our test lab: test benches, network setups and reference substation configurations
Design experimental setups that simulate real substations, including third-party IEDs, switches, clocks and protection relays
Use hardware in the loop devices, such as Omicron or Typhoon-HIL, to inject currents and voltages and verify behaviour
Prepare demo and proof-of-concept setups for customers and exhibitions

Testing and stress testing
Write and run test plans for new hardware revisions and firmware releases
Stress test the products: high network load, many sampled value streams, GOOSE storms, loss of PTP time sync, redundancy failover (PRP/HSR), power cycling and long-duration runs
Run interoperability tests with other vendors' equipment
Prepare for and support type testing, certification and IEC 61850 conformance testing
Automate recurring tests where it makes sense

Analysis and feedback to R&D
Capture and analyse network traffic with tools such as Wireshark
Measure timing, latency, accuracy and synchronisation performance
Reproduce field issues in the lab and find the root cause together with R&D
Write clear test reports and bug reports

Customer support
Help customers and integrators configure our products, including SCL files, sampled values, GOOSE and time sync
Support factory acceptance tests (FAT), site acceptance tests (SAT) and commissioning when needed
Write application notes, configuration guides and test procedures

Who you are
Must have
Degree in electrical engineering, power engineering or a related field
EU citizenship or permanent residency
Practical knowledge of IEC 61850: SCL files, GOOSE and sampled values
Experience building lab setups and running structured tests
Comfortable with network analysis and Ethernet networking
Methodical, curious and good at documenting what you find
Fluent in English, written and spoken

Nice to have
Experience with testing, substation automation, or protection and control
Experience with relay test sets, such as Omicron CMC or Doble
Knowledge of PTP time sync (IEEE 1588, IEC 61850-9-3) and PRP/HSR redundancy
Experience with type testing, EMC or environmental testing
Experience from a utility, system integrator or substation equipment vendor

What we offer
Ownership of our test lab and a direct impact on product quality
Close collaboration with R&D and a direct line to the founders
Hands-on work with the latest digital substation technology
Benefits: Occupational pension (ITP) and a generous wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag)
Location: Primarily in our Gothenburg office, with flexibility on partial remote work

How to apply
Include your CV and a short note on why this role fits you. If you have any questions, reach out to jakob@ecophi.ai.

About us
EcoPhi builds hardware for digital substations. Our two products are the CMPC800, a centralised substation server, and the QMU800, a modular merging unit. Utilities and system integrators use them to modernise the grid with IEC 61850-based protection, control and monitoring.
We are looking for a product manager who will own the CMPC800 and QMU800 end to end: what we build, who we sell it to, and how it reaches the customer.
The role
You are the voice of the customer inside the company and the owner of our product line. You decide, together with the founders and engineering, what goes into the next release and why. You know what utilities ask for in their tenders, where competitors are ahead or behind, and the you guide the direction of our products.
We are a small company, so you will be involved in the real product chain as well. You will draft quotes, follow up with our production partners and make sure customers get what they ordered. That is how you stay close to the customer and the product.
What you will do
Product strategy and roadmap
Own the product roadmap for the CMPC800 and QMU800
Collect customer feedback, feature requests and lost-tender reasons, and turn them into clear priorities
Write product requirements and work with hardware and firmware engineers to deliver them
Decide on product variants, options and new I/O modules based on market demand
Plan firmware releases and communicate what is in them

Market and competition
Follow what utilities, TSOs and DSOs ask for in their digital substation specifications
Track competitors and position our products against them
Identify new markets, customer segments and partnerships with system integrators
Follow standards development, such as IEC 61850, IEC 61869-9 and cybersecurity requirements

Pricing, sales and customer support
Own pricing and price lists together with the founders
Respond to RFIs, RFQs and tenders, and draft quotations
Fill in tender compliance matrices with support from engineering
Present our products to customers and join technical meetings
Maintain datasheets, product presentations and other sales material

Product lifecycle and operations
Plan type testing, certification and utility qualification
Manage component obsolescence and product lifecycle together with engineering
Forecast demand and place orders with production partners
Follow customer orders through to delivery and keep customers updated

Who you are
Must have
3+ years of experience in product management, technical sales or a similar role in a hardware company
Technical background in electrical engineering, electronics or power systems
EU citizenship or permanent residency
Able to turn customer conversations into concrete product requirements and priorities
Comfortable presenting to customers and preparing quotations
Structured, independent and used to owning outcomes
Fluent in English, written and spoken

Nice to have
Experience with substations, protection and control, or IEC 61850
Experience from a utility, a system integrator or a substation equipment vendor
Experience with utility tenders and compliance matrices
Experience working with EMS factories or contract manufacturers

What we offer
Ownership of a product line in a growing company working on the energy transition
Real influence on product direction and a direct line to the founders
Benefits: Occupational pension (ITP) and a generous wellness allowance (friskvårdsbidrag)
Location: Primarily in our Gothenburg office, with flexibility on partial remote work

How to apply
Include your CV and a short note on why this role fits you. If you have any questions, reach out to jakob@ecophi.ai.

ALTEN is seeking a skilled Electrical Development Engineer for an exciting opportunity in the automotive industry. Join a dynamic team and contribute to innovative, customer-specific solutions in a global engineering environment.

• Technical challenges and development opportunities. 
• An inspiring community and the chance to contribute to a sustainable future. 
• Supportive and coaching leadership. 
• The possibility to work across various industries where our clients operate.

About the Role
We are looking for an Electrical Development Engineer to support the development of customized vehicle solutions. In this role, you will design and develop electrical systems and cable harnesses, create schematics, and deliver 3D routing solutions. You will ensure technical solutions are production-ready and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including mechanical engineers, production, suppliers, and colleagues across Sweden and Poland.
This assignment offers the chance to take technical ownership, solve complex engineering challenges, and drive unique customer-specific projects from concept to production.

Responsibilities:
• Design and develop electrical systems and cable harnesses for customized vehicle solutions.
• Create electrical schematics and 3D cable routing solutions.
• Work with both existing and new technical solutions to meet specific customer requirements.
• Take ownership of assigned projects and follow development from concept to production.
• Collaborate with mechanical engineers, production, suppliers, and other engineering teams.
• Ensure electrical designs meet technical requirements and are feasible for production.
• Identify opportunities for improvements and challenge existing ways of working.
• Contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous development within the team.
Your profile
We are looking for a curious, solution-oriented, and eager-to-learn professional who thrives in a collaborative environment. You take ownership of your tasks, enjoy sharing knowledge, and are comfortable challenging existing solutions to drive innovation. Structured and independent, you excel at problem-solving and adapt well to dynamic, changing requirements.

Qualifications:
Must Have:
• University degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or equivalent.

• Practical experience with electrical schematics and system design.
• Proficiency in tools such as Saber and/or CATIA.
• Fluent in English (verbal and written).
Nice to Have:
• Experience with low-voltage (LV) and high-voltage (HV) systems.
• Background in the automotive or heavy vehicle industry.
• Experience taking technical solutions from concept to production.
• Experience working in cross-functional engineering teams.

ABOUT ALTEN 
ALTEN is one of Europe’s largest technology and IT consulting companies, with over 57,000 employees across approximately 30 countries. Our engineers carry out complex and highly technical projects throughout the entire product development chain for leading companies in several industries including Automotive, Defense & Security, Energy, Industrial Equipment, Public Sector, and Life Sciences.

In Sweden, we are approximately 1,300 dedicated employees spread across 9 offices in cities ranging from Lund in the south to Skellefteå in the north.

For the fifth year in a row, ALTEN has been named one of Sweden’s most attractive employers by Karriärföretagen for five consecutive years — an award for companies offering unique career and development opportunities.

Welcome to read more about us at alten.se

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral researcher, aquatic microbial ecology & environmental genomics
jobs.description:
Department of Aquatic Sciences and Assessment
We are looking to recruit a creative and motivated postdoctoral researcher to study microbial diversity and biogeochemical/metabolic function by analysing larger metagenomic and metatranscriptomid datasets from field expeditions and laboratory experiments.
About the position
As a postdoktor, you are expected to;
Organize and analyse large microbial, metagenomic and metatrancriptomic datasets.
Take a leading role in collaborative research focused on microbial ecology and metabolic function with focus on the Central Arctic Ocean.
Interpret and report own research and findings in scientific publications and presentations.
Support and collaborate with colleagues and students in bioinformatic analyses.
Apply for funding to develop the research area further.

Your profile
We are looking for a candidate with a PhD in microbiology, ecology, bioinformatics or related disciplines. Strong skills in bioinformatics and in-depth analyses of microbial genomic data is a requirement for the position. Research experience in aquatic microbial ecology is a merit. Experience in biostatistics, bioinformatic tool development and database handling is a merit. Proficiency in scientific writing demonstrated by first authored publications in international scientific journals is a merit. Mentoring and training of students is a merit. Proficiency in English (written and spoken) is a requirement.
As postdoctoral appointments are career-developing positions for junior researchers, we are primarily looking for candidates with a doctoral degree that is three years old at most. If there are special circumstances, such a degree may have been awarded earlier. Special circumstances include leave due to illness, parental leave, positions of trust within trade union organizations, service within the total defence system, or other similar circumstances, as well as clinical service or other employment/assignments relevant to the subject area.    
About us
The Department of Aquatic Sciences and Assessment is working with applied environmental science, with a national responsibility for assessing the condition of Swedish surface waters with respect to water chemistry, pollution and aquatic biota. The research focuses on geochemical and hydrological processes, aquatic ecology and biodiversity, microbial ecology as well as on environmental chemistry and aquatic ecotoxicology. The department has about 150 employees, of which approximately half are researchers/doctoral students and the other half are technical and administrative staff.
For more information about the department visit: http://www.slu.se/aquatic-sciences
Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. jobs.occupation: Material Planner at a Global Life Science Company!
jobs.description:
Join a leading global player in the healthcare sector as a Material Planner. In this role, your expertise directly ensures the smooth production of life-saving medical products within a structured, collaborative, and fast-paced team environment.
About the role
As a Material Planner, you will serve as the vital link between customer demand, material supply, and internal production. Working closely with a dedicated team of buyers and planners, your primary focus will be driving daily operational flows to prevent material bottlenecks and secure on-time deliveries. This is a hands-on, execution-focused position where your proactive coordination makes a tangible impact on global healthcare supply chains.
You are offered
A long-term consultant assignment up to one year at an industry-leading company.
Structured onboarding with dedicated mentors to ensure you feel confident in your role from day one.
Hybrid flexibility – once you are fully onboarded, you will have the option to work remotely one day per week.

Work tasks
In this role, you will manage operational material planning for the main production line, ensuring high material availability and accurate system data. Your daily tasks include:
Manage operational material planning for the main production line to ensure optimal material availability.  
Coordinate with internal functions such as purchasing, warehouse, and production to resolve material shortages.  
Execute and maintain work orders and customer orders within the ERP system (Oracle).  
Prioritize customer orders and actively monitor potential material bottleneck lists.  
Investigate inventory discrepancies, identify root causes, and perform necessary stock adjustments.  
Update and communicate production priority lists to keep all operational teams aligned.  
Participate in daily management meetings to report on material status and escalate risks when necessary.

We are looking for
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, or equivalent work experience.
At least 2 years of experience in in operational planning flows - such as production planning, material control, or order management, within manufacturing, laboratory operations, or similar environments.
Hands-on experience working with ERP systems (specifically managing production orders, sales orders, and inventory transactions) as well as MRP/production planning tools.
Understanding of material planning, lead times, production capacity, inventory accuracy, and backorder management.
Ability to manage shifting priorities, coordinate work across different functions, and drive issues through to resolution.
Fluency in English (written and spoken).

It is meritorious if you have
Basic knowledge of Swedish.
Experience from manufacturing processes within the Life Science, MedTech, or Healthcare sectors.

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Intellectually curious: You are a fast learner who understands digital workflows and how different processes interconnect within an ERP environment.
Strong at prioritizing: You are able to balance customer commitments, material constraints, and production capacity.
Social: You build strong cross-functional relationships and communicate priorities clearly.
Orderly: You ensure reliable planning data, accurate transactions, and up-to-date follow-up lists.
Responsible: You take ownership of tasks and drive issues through to resolution.
Stable: You maintain focus and act flexibly when material shortages, demand, or priorities shift.

 
Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

The role drives local execution of central strategy, oversees rider training, recruitment, and performance management, while ensuring workplace responsibility for thousands of riders and office employees. 5-6 years of Last mile logistics experience with at least 2–3 years of solid managerial experience successfully leading and managing a large team.

Bilingual or full professional proficiency in both Swedish and English (strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages).

Ability to thrive in a fast paced environment

At foodora, we expect every employee to act in alignment with our leadership principles; Own it, Dive Deep, Deliver Value Fast, Raise The Bar, Bring Good Vibes and Stay Humble. Meaning: Own your work, understand it deeply, move fast on what matters, lift and raise the bar for yourself and others, spread positivity, and stay curious and humble every step of the way.

Wellness allowance topped with the opportunity to participate in many work/life balance initiatives at foodora such as wellness hour & reduced price on massage.

Employee discount at foodora (woho!)

Application:
Are you ready to take the next step in your career and contribute to Biotage’s continued growth journey? We look forward to receiving your application. Please submit your application as soon as possible, as selection may take place on an ongoing basis.

Are you an experienced mechanic who enjoys hands-on work, troubleshooting technical equipment, and working in a dynamic site environment? We are looking for a skilled and motivated Mechanic to join our team and help ensure the reliability and performance of our equipment and machinery.
Main Responsibilities as a Mechanic

The role combines mechanical maintenance with welding and steel fabrication work to support daily operations and minimize downtime.
Key Responsibilities
Service, maintenance, and repair of tunnel machines and associated equipment.
Preventive and corrective maintenance of site vehicles, site cars, pumps, generators, and other machinery.
Troubleshooting and fault-finding on mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems.
Welding, steel fabrication, and repair work as required.
Inspection of equipment to ensure safe and efficient operation.
Replacement of worn or damaged components.
Documentation of maintenance activities and repair records.
Support operational teams with technical expertise and rapid response to breakdowns.
Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with safety procedures and company standards.

Qualifications and Experience
We are looking for candidates who have:
Relevant mechanical or technical education, or equivalent work experience.
Experience in maintenance and repair of heavy equipment, construction machinery, industrial equipment, or vehicles.
Good knowledge of mechanical systems, hydraulics, and pneumatics.
Practical experience in welding and steelwork.
Ability to read and understand technical drawings and manuals
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
A valid driver's license (Category B)

The following are considered an advantage:
Experience working in tunneling, mining, construction, or infrastructure projects.
Knowledge of diesel engines and hydraulic systems.
Welding certifications.
Experience with heavy construction equipment and pumps.

Personal Qualities
You are a reliable and safety-conscious team player who takes pride in delivering high-quality work. You work independently when required, have a proactive attitude, and thrive in a fast-paced operational environment.
What We Offer
As an international company, we offer a truly global environment, reflected in both our offices and projects. You will have many opportunities to collaborate with colleagues from different parts of the world, supporting both your personal and professional growth. We are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and offer a wellness allowance.

jobs.occupation: Advance Your Orthopaedic Career in Coastal Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Dignus Medical collaborates with several established healthcare providers across Sweden. We are currently receiving ongoing requests from hospitals in central Sweden seeking specialist physicians in orthopaedics. These opportunities arise regularly as healthcare providers expand their orthopaedic services and strengthen their specialist teams.
We are continuously interested in connecting with Orthopaedic Surgeons who are open to exploring professional opportunities in Sweden.
The Role
As a specialist in orthopaedics, you will work in a modern hospital environment alongside multidisciplinary teams focused on high-quality patient care. The clinical work typically includes both elective orthopaedic surgery and acute trauma care, depending on the structure of the department.
Common responsibilities include:
Assessment and treatment of musculoskeletal disorders and injuries
Elective orthopaedic procedures depending on experience and subspecialty
Participation in trauma and emergency orthopaedic care
Outpatient consultations and follow-up care
Collaboration with physiotherapists, radiologists, and other medical specialists
Participation in clinical development and quality improvement work

Hospitals in this region often manage a broad orthopaedic case mix, offering opportunities to work with both common orthopaedic conditions and more complex cases.
Location and Lifestyle
The opportunities are located in a region of central Sweden known for its coastal landscapes, forests, rivers, and open countryside. The area offers excellent access to nature and outdoor activities year-round, including hiking, fishing, skiing, and boating.
Daily life is practical and well-organized. Cities in this region offer short commuting distances, accessible housing, and well-developed public services. Schools, childcare, and healthcare services are easily available, making the region suitable both for individuals relocating alone and for physicians moving with their families.
The lifestyle combines a calm environment with reliable infrastructure and convenient travel connections to larger Swedish cities.
Qualifications
EU-recognized specialist certification in Orthopaedics
Solid clinical experience in orthopaedic practice
Experience in trauma care and elective orthopaedic procedures is beneficial
Ability to work independently while collaborating in multidisciplinary teams
Good communication skills in English
Willingness to learn Swedish

What Dignus Medical Offers You
Ongoing support from a dedicated recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals, if required
Help with accommodation and travel arrangements, including support for your family, if necessary
Access to a free language course with a private tutor

Why Choose Dignus Medical?
We are a trusted recruitment partner with over 20 years of experience helping medical professionals establish careers in Sweden. Our focus is on long-term success for both candidates and healthcare providers. From your first contact to your first day at work, we are with you every step of the way.
Interested in learning more?
Contact us to learn more about current and upcoming opportunities for orthopaedic specialists in Sweden, or submit your application today. Dignus Medical looks forward to helping you explore the next step in your career.
We look forward to receiving your application!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

The Supply chain and Procurement Manager supports the entire lifecycle of our enzyme-based solutions—from procuring raw materials and components to delivering the final product to the customer. The role
We are seeking an agile and strategic Supply chain and Procurement Manager to lead our supply chain from start to finish, from the suppliers we buy from, through our contract manufacturers, to the customers who receive our products. In this multifaceted role, supporting our product line director and the overall company activity, you will be responsible for procuring highly specific materials related to enzymes and biomanufacturing, managing day-to-day activities with existing raw material suppliers and production facility, supporting cost-saving procurement strategies, and optimizing logistics networks. You will also oversee daily warehouse, fulfilment, international shipping and business workflows to maximise productivity and efficiency. The ideal candidate is a master of cross-functional execution who balances hands-on operational ownership and a higher-level picture of supply chain and process efficiency oversight.

Manage the purchasing of raw materials, from request to delivery.
Identify and qualify new suppliers and CMOs in collaboration with the Product Line Director 
Develop and maintain the supply base, focusing on quality, delivery and cost efficiency.
Establish and update agreements with key suppliers and CMOs, including pricing and purchase terms.
Plan and coordinate material supply for production campaigns at our CMOs, and follow up on timelines.
Monitor inventory levels to secure material availability while avoiding excess stock.
Coordinate inbound and outbound shipments, and ensure compliance with import/export regulations.
Follow up on spend against budget and drive cost-saving initiatives as needed.
Streamline daily operations and improve processes for ordering, receiving and shipping. 

Who you are
Required
A university degree in supply chain management, logistics, industrial engineering or similar.
At least 5 years of experience in production planning, supply chain or procurement within the manufacturing industry, specialty chemicals, cosmetics, food or a similar industry.
Experience from driving cross-functional collaboration, improvement work and process development.
Excellent English skills, both spoken and written

Nice to have
Experience navigating global trade tariffs, customs clearance protocols, and international sourcing networks.
Proven ability to operate as subject matter expert in a company building its operations function.
Experience in a scale-up moving from R&D to pilot or commercial production, including technology transfer to CMOs.

 
What we offer
A people-driven, forward-looking company of 30+ people from more than 15 nationalities;
A fast-moving, collaborative and multidisciplinary team shaping the future of industrial biotech;
A start-up environment with minimal red tape, real responsibility and ownership, and room to learn and grow;
A competitive salary and wellness grant;
25 days of paid annual leave plus bridge days, occupational health and injury insurance, and an occupational pension plan mirroring ITP-1.
